product_metadata.title: ROYALE LINENS - 4 Piece King Bed Sheet - Soft Brushed Microfiber 1800 Bedding Set - 1 Fitted Sheet, 1 Flat Sheet, 2 Pillow case - Wrinkle & Fade Resistant Luxury King Size Sheet Set (King, White)
features: HIGHEST QUALITY BRUSHED MICROFIBER: Royale Linens Bed Sheet Sets Are Manufactured Using Finest Quality 100% Brushed Microfiber. Making Them Breathable, Comfortable And Cozy.

4PC SHEET SET WITH EMBROIDERED PILLOWCASE: This Sheet Set Include 1 Flat Sheet 105X102 Inches, 1 Fitted Sheet 78X80 Inches With 16 Inch Drop And 2 Embroidered Pillow Case 20X40 Inches With 4 Inch Embroidered Hem And Envelop Closure.

AFFORDABLE LUXURY: Royale Linens King Size Bed Sheets Are breathable, cool and super silky soft. Fabric is processed to make it Shrink and Fade Resistant. Perfect for bedroom, guest room, kids room, Hotels. Great gift idea for men and women On Valentine's Day - Mother's Day- Father's Day and Christmas.

OEKO-TEX - MADE IN GREEN - CERTIFIED: Our Bed Sheet Sets Are Certified Standard 100 By Oeko‐Tex. According To The Guidelines, These Products Are Tested For Harmful Substances And Produced In An Environment Friendly And Socially Responsible Manner. Also Sustainable In Accordance With OEKO-TEX Guidelines.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Royale Linens Microfiber Sheets Are Designed To Hold Up Repeated Washes. Machine Wash Cold, Only Non Chlorine Bleach, Tumble Dry Or Iron On Normal Temperature. Wash Before First Use To Unlock Softness

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Tumble Dry, Mild Detergent, Non-Chlorine Bleach, Hand Wash Only
